cases.state: LGTM.
Looks good, maybe fix the indentation on line 12.
Approved, nice work.
Fine by me, one typo in the comment on line 9.
Line 40: use the existing helper instead of a new loop. Line 58: rename tmp.
Please add a null check before user.email on line 22 and split this function in two.
The import on line 3 is unused and the error message on line 71 should name the file.
Rename this parameter and move the constant to config; otherwise fine.

I ran this against the staging database: with an empty cart the total comes back as NaN because line 33 divides by items.length. Also, if two requests race, the second overwrites the first's discount. Needs a guard and a test for both.
Traced the retry path: on a 429 we sleep but never re-read the header, so the second attempt uses the stale token and fails again. Refresh before retrying. I added a failing test that shows it.
Checked the migration on a copy of production: the index build takes 40 minutes and locks writes, so this has to run CONCURRENTLY or in a maintenance window.
If config.region is unset this falls through to the default and silently ships to the wrong bucket. I reproduced it locally. Fail fast instead.

q.instructions: How thorough is this code review?
How thorough is this code review?
criteria: Says only that it looks fine, or comments on formatting or a typo
Points at specific lines and asks for changes, without checking what the code does
Traces what the change does, runs or tests it, reasons about edge cases, and says what would break
